title: Door leaf
author: the #411 acceptance suite
description: One door leaf, 80 by 8 units, hinged at the instance's origin. open (0 to 1) is how far it is open, swing the angle it turns through when fully open; a driver in the document turns the instance.

open.about: how far the door is open, 0 shut to 1 fully open

swing.about: the angle the door turns through when fully open
